Product guides and documents

User Manual (PDF)

Product Description

Samsung's Essential S3 Curved Monitor creates an immersive viewing experience for your everyday use. The 1800R curved screen wraps more closely around the field of vision for a wider view which enhances depth perception and minimizes peripheral distractions. The 100Hz refresh rate reduces lag and motion blur to stay in the action when playing games, watching videos, or working on creative projects. Game Mode offers instant adjustment of color and image contrast, filling the screen with a clear view of every detail. Advanced eye comfort technology certified by TÜV reduces eye strain by minimizing blue light and decreasing irritating screen flicker. HDMI and D-sub enable devices to be plugged straight into the monitor for greater connectivity and convenience. ¹Default refresh rate is set to 60Hz, and may be adjusted to 100Hz in the monitor's settings. ² Image simulated for demonstration purposes.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Reliable 27" Screen with Clear Picture and Easy Setup
    I’ve been using the Samsung 27" Essential S3 (S36GD) for a couple of weeks now, mainly with my Xbox, and it’s been a really solid upgrade from my older 24" screen. Setup was easy I just plugged it into my Xbox and it worked right away with no issues. The jump to 27 inches is definitely noticeable. Everything feels more immersive when gaming, and even smaller details are easier to pick up. I’ve been playing a lot of Fortnite on it, and it’s been a good experience. The colors look nice and the image stays clear, even during fast movement. It’s easier to spot things in the distance compared to my old monitor, which actually makes a difference when playing. The picture quality overall is solid for what I need. It’s not a high-end gaming monitor, but for casual gaming and everyday use it does the job well. I didn’t notice any major lag or issues while playing. One thing I liked more than I expected is how slim it is. It doesn’t take up much space on my desk and has a clean look. The stand is basic but stable. The only small downside is there’s not much adjustability, so you have to work around that a bit. I’ve also used it for YouTube and general browsing, and it works perfectly fine there too. No eye strain even after longer sessions. I honestly think this is a great value if you want a bigger screen for gaming and everyday use without spending a lot. It’s simple, reliable, and does exactly what I needed.

      I’ve been using the Samsung 27" Essential S3 (S36GD) for a couple of weeks now, mainly with my Xbox, and it’s been a really solid upgrade from my older 24" screen.

      Setup was easy I just plugged it into my Xbox and it worked right away with no issues. The jump to 27 inches is definitely noticeable. Everything feels more immersive when gaming, and even smaller details are easier to pick up.

      I’ve been playing a lot of Fortnite on it, and it’s been a good experience. The colors look nice and the image stays clear, even during fast movement. It’s easier to spot things in the distance compared to my old monitor, which actually makes a difference when playing.

      The picture quality overall is solid for what I need. It’s not a high-end gaming monitor, but for casual gaming and everyday use it does the job well. I didn’t notice any major lag or issues while playing. One thing I liked more than I expected is how slim it is. It doesn’t take up much space on my desk and has a clean look. The stand is basic but stable. The only small downside is there’s not much adjustability, so you have to work around that a bit. I’ve also used it for YouTube and general browsing, and it works perfectly fine there too. No eye strain even after longer sessions. I honestly think this is a great value if you want a bigger screen for gaming and everyday use without spending a lot. It’s simple, reliable, and does exactly what I needed.

      5 out of 5 stars
      for a budget monitor I couldnt be happier with it
      Reviewed in the United States on May 29, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I snagged one of these along with one of the flat monitors for a new system recently. The flat model was $149, while this one was $119, and yet this one is worlds nicer than the flat model. The colors are more even, the blacks are darker, the menu has more options, and as someone that has never had a curved model before I think it looks amazing. If it weren't such a pain to return the flat model and get a second one of these, I would do it in a heartbeat. The only thing I could see might be an issue for some people, is the stand on this model isn't adjustable almost at all. It is very stable, and if you plan to put it on a mounting arm it wont matter, but if you need to constantly adjust the angle of the monitor you might have an issue on some desks with this stand. However everything else is fantastic. If you are looking for a good budget monitor I can't recommend this one enough, even over other models in the same product line. If you are looking at the flat models, save yourself the disappointment and the $30 and go for this one instead.

    • Misha T
      4 out of 5 stars
      Good tv for basic use, not the best for gaming
      Reviewed in the United States on September 5, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Lightweight, the base that holds it takes up a lot if space so I go a mounting rack that attaches to a desk, so much space saved. Picture quality varies, especially during video games. Make sure to change the screen refresh rate to 100hz, otherwise games will look terrible. And even at 100hz, they’re still kinda of iffy.

      I bought two and both screens are different colors even when all the settings are the same. One is much more vibrant than the other. Mounting was pretty easy so that was nice. Compatible with pc, Mac and gaming consoles. I used with hdmi to hdmi, hdmi to usb c and hdmi to DisplayPort. All worked fine except the pc to display port when the monitor is set to 100hz, for some reason if the pc would go to sleep, the monitor would begin to flash in and off once the pc was woken up. Only way to solve it is to restart the computer. It’s not the cable or of as even when the ports are switched, the same monitor turns off and on.

      Seems kind of durable. As durable as a 130 buck tv can be. As long as you don’t throw anything at it or drop it you’ll be fine. Worth it’s value, gold entry level tv/minitor.

    • Olive Muffin
      4 out of 5 stars
      Please read Specs: A decent value curved monitor with some drawbacks.
      Reviewed in the United States on January 27, 2025
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      OVERALL: This is a decent curved monitor, screen looks nice, easy to assemble, some minor drawbacks. Good Value.

      Background: I am using this monitor to hook up to my mini computer and my Nintendo Switch. This is my second curved monitor that I have owned. Both have been Samsung monitors as my first one was wonderful but got damaged in a flood. So when I was going to set up a new workstation I default went to Samsung to replace my old Samsung. I found this monitor and ordered it quickly. Shipping was fast and it came in undamaged.

      The Good:

      Monitor was easy to set up.

      It is a good size.

      Screen looks good.

      The Neutral/Bad:

      Monitor boasts a 100 hrtz refresh rate. While this is fine for my needs (switch and basic computing) this is probably not good enough for a heavy gamer or someone dealing with advanced graphics.

      The monitor only has 01 HDMI input. I find this annoying and I have to buy a HDMI switch in order to switch between my nintendo and my computer.

      The Monitor does not have built in speakers. My last one had built in speakers and I was spoiled with that simple feature.

      Overall if you are looking for a basic curved monitor with decent specs, I believe this is a good candidate. However if you are looking for something with the most advanced refresh rates and multiple HDMI inputs, you may want to look a tier or two up.

      I have included pictures of monitor front and the back (so you can see the inputs).
